headline: OpenAI launches visual 'Intelligent UI' update for ChatGPT
summary: OpenAI is rolling out a new 'Intelligent UI' for ChatGPT, alongside GPT-6, that lets the chatbot combine text responses with interactive visuals such as diagrams, charts, forms, and tappable buttons rather than plain text alone.

claims.statement: OpenAI is launching a new 'Intelligent UI' for ChatGPT that generates interactive visual elements alongside text responses.

sources.quote: an “Intelligent UI” that’s more visual—generating interactive elements as part of the chatbot’s outputs
gives ChatGPT the ability to combine a text response with diagrams, charts, forms, tappable buttons, and more

claims.statement: The update is rolling out to all users alongside the new GPT-6 model.

sources.quote: rolling out to all users alongside GPT-6
OpenAI is updating ChatGPT for all users
